info.name: Parent App (Flutter) — localhost
info.description:
Parent APK API. Full localhost URLs (API gateway :5000), no baseUrl variable.
Run "01 Auth → Login" first — {{token}} AND {{childId}} (first child) are saved automatically.
Everything about a child is under /children/{{childId}}/… — switching child in the app = changing this id.
Bottom nav: HOME · ACADEMICS · ATTENDANCE · NOTICES · PROFILE (+ 🔔). Fees / Receipts / Pickup / Settings open from Profile.
